parsed.post: Huge jump! Tried expanding TRAIN_SHARDS to '0-10' and saw val_bpb drop from 1.042 to 0.892. Seems like using all available data is highly effective. Next, I'll try increasing DEPTH to 6 to see if more capacity helps now that the data bottleneck is addressed.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH from 4 to 6 while keeping the expanded TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' to test if increased model capacity improves performance with more data.
